items.title: Threema Secure Messaging Service Hit by Massive DDoS Attack
items.description: Threema, a privacy-focused secure messaging service, was hit by a series of large-scale distributed denial-of-service (DDoS attacks) that temporarily disrupted access for users. The incidents affected the platform on Tuesday evening and continued intermittently through Wednesday morning before normal operations were restored. items.description: Roundcube has released versions 1.6.18 and 1.7.3 to address eleven security vulnerabilities affecting its webmail platform. items.title: GeoServer’s Unauthenticated SQL injection Vulnerability Enables RCE Attacks
items.description: GeoServer administrators should urgently update affected systems after researchers disclosed an unauthenticated SQL injection flaw in the jsonArrayContains filter function.
